[SWS_CM_90467] Payload of the Normal or Application Error Response
⌈
For E2E-protected Methods the Method inout and out arguments or the applica-
tion error shall be serialized and a protocol header shall be potentially added according
to the rules of the respective network binding (e.g., according to [SWS_CM_10312] in
case of SOME/IP network binding), resulting in the serialized data.
⌋
